About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

The Role

Moderna continues to expand its innovative mRNA platform, unlocking new applications across diseases and therapeutic areas. As the company advances its oncology pipeline, including intismeran autogene, a personalized investigational mRNA therapy being developed in collaboration with Merck, this role will play a critical part in preparing for the potential launch of Moderna’s first commercial therapeutic in oncology.

Moderna’s intismeran autogene (INT) program represents an exciting advancement in personalized cancer treatment, leveraging the power of mRNA technology to develop therapies tailored to each patient’s unique tumor profile. This innovative approach has the potential to redefine the future of cancer care and marks a significant milestone in Moderna’s evolution beyond infectious diseases. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the commercial launch of a pioneering oncology program and play a foundational role in building Moderna’s oncology business.

Moderna is seeking a Sr. Director, Regional Sales, West, who will build, lead, and develop the West Region Oncology Sales team to drive regional sales strategy and execution for a co-promoted solid tumor oncology asset. This role is accountable for regional sales performance, oncology launch excellence, performance management and field execution across complex account ecosystems, while partnering closely with an alliance partner. The role requires deep expertise in oncology, and knowledge of account dynamics, experience building high performing teams, strong communication skills, analytical skills, ability to execute while partnering closely with the alliance, as well as proven leadership in a launch environment. This position is also responsible for building key business relationships with multi-disciplinary stakeholders across key health systems, accounts and large practice networks.

You combine strong sales and people leadership expertise with deep oncology knowledge and are comfortable partnering with alliance or other matrix partners to drive solutions that are best for patients and business. You are a collaborative thinker who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and brings a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

Candidates based in California or Colorado are preferred.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Establish and lead the West Region Oncology Sales team, recruiting and developing sales professionals to deliver on sales goals and performance KPIs through effective product communication, execution of brand strategy, and collaboration with internal and alliance partners.
  • Develop and execute regional strategic account plans that leverage market insights to strengthen customer relationships, achieve sales targets, and facilitate growth within targeted accounts to support the successful launch of intismeran.
  • Collaborate internally and with our alliance partner to ensure effective, coordinated engagement of key accounts, and account leadership, compliantly tailoring the brand strategy to influence value drivers within each account.
  • Expertise in clinical data, disease state, and account management to provide direction to the field team and insights to the commercial organization.
  • Identify market trends and opportunities and proactively communicate with Oncology leadership.
  • Develop a high-performance culture by consistently providing coaching, performance management, and ongoing development for field teams.
  • Lead from the front through the frequent engagement of customers while partnering with the sales team exemplifying the skills, behaviors and attitude required to be successful by selling an innovative product in a complex environment and creating a culture of continuous learning and development.
  • Use data and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and monitor field performance, adapting quickly to emerging trends or needs.
  • Represent Moderna at high-level external engagements, including conferences, scientific forums, and engagements with key oncology stakeholders.
  • Partner as a peer with cross-functional leads across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and the alliance ensuring a high level of communication and coordination to foster a positive customer experience.
  • Manage and deploy resources to ensure the achievement of objectives and manage regional budgets to ensure appropriate utilization of funds.
  • Ensure full compliance with Moderna policies and all applicable healthcare laws and regulations.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree required·
  • Minimum of 10 years of pharmaceutical/biotech commercial experience, with demonstrated experience in oncology and field account strategy
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading oncology sales teams
  • Ability to travel up to 75%
  • Must reside within the assigned geographic region

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leading product launches in oncology
  • Prior experience in melanoma is highly preferred
  • Experience successfully launching and executing in an alliance relationship is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience building high performing teams
  • Deep knowledge of key customer types including academic, community, IDN, and GPO affiliated oncology programs
  • Demonstrated background leading teams focused on account management while selling complex products and engaging multiple account stakeholders and specialties
  • Experience working in a solution oriented, dynamic, startup environment
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with cross function partners to ensure the appropriate coordinated engagement of all account types
  • Proven ability to utilize market knowledge and analytics to drive regional strategies, effective targeting, and achievement of sales goals
  • Fluency in data-driven decision-making and CRM utilization for field strategy
  • High adaptability, solution-oriented mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity and a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape
  • Exceptional interpersonal, leadership, communication and influencing skills
  • A desire to make an impact as part of a high-growth, transformational company that is Bold, Relentless, Curious, and Collaborative

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown

raw.excerpt: ABOUT USARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry.
raw.description:
ABOUT US

ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry. Playing a key role in the success of its clients, which include Pragmatic Play, a brand relied upon by the world’s biggest online casinos for its cutting-edge products, ARRISE helps to deliver exceptional gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide.
Our global team of over 13,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.
At ARRISE, we take pride in creating growth opportunities at all levels, constantly investing in our people while welcoming new colleagues and forging strategic partnerships that open new opportunities for success.
To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.
Be part of the future of iGaming with 13,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join our Data Science team as a Data Scientist working at the applied-research end of computer vision. You will frame open-ended problems as testable hypotheses, develop prototypes to validate them, and choose the model architectures and methods best suited to each. Computer vision is the core domain, with scope to work across text, audio, and tabular data. Working with ML Engineers, you will help take validated prototypes into production and see them run at scale.
Even if you don't meet every requirement, your skills and ability to deliver impact are what matter most.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design and prototype ML and deep learning models, with computer vision as the primary domain (object detection, classification, tracking).
  • Frame business problems as testable hypotheses and develop proofs-of-concept to validate them, iterating on the results.
  • Evaluate and benchmark competing model architectures and pre-trained models to identify the best-fit approach.
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers to scale validated prototypes into production systems and stay engaged through deployment.
  • Track experiments, manage model and data versioning, and define evaluation metrics to compare approaches objectively.
  • Work with product, engineering, and business teams to turn objectives into applied ML solutions.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

  • Master's degree in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Hands-on experience developing ML and deep learning models, including demonstrated computer vision work.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Experience with computer vision models for object detection, image classification, and tracking.
  • Solid grounding in deep learning, traditional computer vision, and classical ML.
  • Strong experimentation mindset: benchmarking, ablation studies, and structured evaluation of competing approaches.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.

Nice to have

  • Experience collaborating with ML Engineers to bring models into production.
  • Experience with any major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for ML training and deployment.
  • Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, vision transformers, or self-supervised / representation learning.
  • Exposure to generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack), or LLM fine-tuning.
  • Background in gaming, iGaming, e-commerce, or other consumer-facing applications at scale.

How we work

Our stack includes Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow, experiment tracking and model versioning, containerized deployment with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Data Scientists and ML Engineers work together across the full lifecycle, from early research through to models running in production.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

  • Work on substantial, real-world computer vision and deep learning problems at scale.
  • End-to-end involvement, from research and prototyping through to production.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment with visible impact.

Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

Protein Metrics is the leading provider of protein characterization software that allows scientists to perform highly-accurate analyses on the data generated from mass spectrometry and other analytical platforms. Our customers include 150+ biopharma companies and 300+ academic organization. Byosphere represents the latest innovation in vendor-neutral analysis software, bringing the industry-leading Byos software to the cloud with computational automation and visualization capabilities built-in.

Protein Metrics is looking for an experienced Sales Manager based in Germany to sell and promote Protein Metrics solutions to customers directly in the DACH region. The candidate must have a knowledge of the biopharmaceutical and protein characterization markets. Sales experience of Enterprise deployments would be a significant advantage. Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales EMEAI, you will be responsible for day-to-day sales and business development for the region. You will need to coordinate closely with the Customer Success team to plan demonstrations, pre-sales activities, quotations and post-sales follow up to biopharmaceutical organizations, academic laboratories, and partners across the region.

In this role you will get to:

  • Weekly and quarterly reporting in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system for sales activities and pipeline; prepare quarterly sales summaries.
  • Coordination with sales teams across other geographies for global accounts
  • Find new customers for Protein Metrics, with a particular focus on Enterprise deployments, by establishing and leveraging partnerships with MS vendors in the region
  • Manage current customer base and ensure expansion for Protein Metrics solutions
  • Assist Marketing in identifying gaps in information or knowledge of Protein Metrics in the market.
  • Ensure best practices are applied at all levels in each account; maintain high level business contacts in parallel with scientific contacts with the Customer Success team.
  • Coordination with Customer Success teams to ensure that Demonstration requests, Deployment requests, and Pilot programs are all delivered on time.
  • Ensure feedback of customer requests to Product Management for actionable improvements to the products
  • Act as a resource to our customers to help build ROI justification for Protein Metrics software
  • Coordinate with Marketing to support marketing initiatives (conference and webinar support, business development, etc.)

We are looking for people who have8+ years experience with Life Sciences software sales, both Enterprise and Desktop or equivalent experience in instrument sales. You will thrive in a remote working environment and be comfortable with travel (20-40%)

The key skills we are looking for in an ideal candidate are:

  • Experience selling to enterprise level customers in the DACH region
  • Proven track record of achieving 1mil+ new business annual quota
  • Experience negotiating and selling deals larger than 50k
  • Experience with protein mass spectrometry applications in biopharma and proteomics (large molecule preferred)
  • Proven experience acquiring and selling to customers using various sales methodologies
  • Proven Expereince with Biopharma industry
  • Comfortable with a matrixed working environment and highly autonomous
  • Language proficiency: English and German

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to join our fast-paced digital agency, someone who combines deep SEO expertise with AI-driven search strategy, automation thinking, and a strong understanding of how search is evolving beyond traditional SERPs.

This role is ideal for someone who understands not only Google rankings, but also visibility across AI-powered search ecosystems including Google AI Overviews (AIO), ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other LLM-driven discovery platforms.

You'll manage and grow the organic performance of multiple client accounts across diverse industries, driving measurable business impact through technical SEO, semantic optimization, automation workflows, and AI-assisted execution.

This is a remote position and requires strong communication, self-management, and proficiency in remote collaboration tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. SEO Strategy & Account Management

  • Develop and execute end-to-end SEO strategies for multiple client accounts.
  • Conduct SEO audits, define KPIs, and deliver measurable growth in traffic, visibility, and conversions.
  • Stay ahead of Google algorithm updates, AI Overviews (AIO), GEO trends, and AI-driven ranking systems.
  • Translate technical and analytical findings into actionable client recommendations.
  • Research, prepare, and present SEO growth plans, performance reports, and strategic opportunities.
  • Support visibility growth across traditional SERPs and AI-powered search environments.

2. Keyword, Intent, Entity & Market Research

  • Conduct advanced keyword, entity, and topical authority research using AI-powered SEO tools.
  • Identify semantic clusters, search intent opportunities, and conversational search trends.
  • Map keywords and entities across the user journey to support SEO and GEO strategies.
  • Discover zero-click, featured snippet, and AI-generated search opportunities.
  • Benchmark competitor SEO, content, and SERP strategies to identify growth gaps.
  • Build content clusters designed for semantic relevance and AI retrieval systems.

3. AI Search, GEO & LLM Optimization

  • Optimize websites and content for Google AI Overviews (AIO), ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging AI search platforms.
  • Support GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategies focused on entity authority and semantic relevance.
  • Structure content for AI retrieval, summarization, and answer-engine discoverability.
  • Implement AI-first SEO practices including conversational search optimization and topical entity mapping.
  • Monitor changes in AI-generated search results and identify new visibility opportunities.

4. On-Page & Content Optimization

  • Prepare SEO-first content briefs and collaborate closely with content writers.
  • Use AI and NLP tools (ChatGPT, SurferSEO, Frase, Jasper, Gemini) to improve content relevance and depth.
  • Ensure content aligns with EEAT (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) principles.
  • Optimize metadata, schema markup, heading structures, internal links, and semantic relevance.
  • Improve content for featured snippets, People Also Ask, AI summaries, and rich search results.

5. Technical SEO & Automation

  • Perform advanced technical SEO audits using Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, and enterprise crawling tools.
  • Resolve crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, Core Web Vitals, and performance issues.
  • Work with developers to ensure SEO best practices are implemented correctly.
  • Implement structured data and scalable technical SEO frameworks.
  • Build and support SEO automation workflows using Python, APIs, AI tools, or no-code platforms.
  • Support large-scale websites, multi-domain structures, and international SEO implementations.

6. Off-Page SEO, Digital PR & Authority Building

  • Develop ethical and scalable link-building and authority-building campaigns.
  • Support AI-assisted outreach and personalization workflows.
  • Monitor backlink quality, toxic links, and domain authority metrics.
  • Collaborate on digital PR and brand visibility initiatives.

7. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Measure SEO performance using GA4, GSC, Looker Studio, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other analytics platforms.
  • Build insightful dashboards aligned with business KPIs and organic growth objectives.
  • Track visibility across traditional SERPs and AI-generated search experiences.
  • Use AI and automation to improve reporting efficiency and performance analysis.
  • Identify optimization opportunities using trends, anomalies, and competitive insights.

Requirements

Tools & PlatformsCore SEO Tools: Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, GTM

AI & Automation Tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, SurferSEO, Frase, Jasper, ContentKing, Sitebulb, AirOps, NotebookLM

  • 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably within a digital agency environment.
  • Proven experience driving measurable SEO growth across multiple projects or industries.
  • Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, and semantic optimization.
  • Experience with AI Overviews (AIO), GEO, and AI-assisted search optimization.
  • Understanding of how LLMs retrieve, summarize, and surface content.
  • Experience using AI tools and automation workflows within SEO operations.
  • Familiarity with automation platforms for SEO workflows is highly preferred.
  • Strong analytical thinking and performance-driven mindset.
  • Excellent communication, reporting, presentation, and client-management skills.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, IT, or a related field.

If you are passionate about SEO, AI search, content systems, automation, and data-driven growth, this role is for you. Please submit your resume and portfolio for consideration.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary & Growth Opportunities
  • Advanced Training in AI Search, GEO & SEO Automation
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact global projects
  • Exposure to cutting-edge SEO and AI workflows
  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven agency environment

Job Title: Global Data Science Lead

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

The Global Analytics Business Consulting Team applies data science and AI to help customers turn commercial, medical, and regulatory data into action. We are seeking a Global Data Science Lead that will support execution of the Data Science AI strategy within this team. This role will lead a group of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and analysts, and partners with Global Analytics leadership to turn strategy into delivery — applying advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI/LLM techniques to life sciences data.

What You'll Do

    • Lead the Data Science function within the Global Analytics Team, in line with Veeva's Analytics Business Consulting goals
    • Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and analysts within the Global Analytics Team
    • Partner with Global Analytics leadership to translate the broader Data Science AI strategy into team priorities and delivery plans
    • Own global methodology – model management, observability, testing, and deployment
    • Foster collaboration between consulting, data science, and engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of AI-driven data solutions
    • Oversee the design and implementation of advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI/LLM models within the Global Analytics Team's scope of work
    • Ensure the development and maintenance of robust, scalable, and efficient data and AI infrastructure supporting Global Analytics Team deliverables
    • Collaborate with cross-functional consulting teams to understand customer business requirements and translate them into AI-native, data-driven solutions
    • Work with product and business stakeholders to surface opportunities for applying AI within Global Analytics Team engagements
    • Enforce best practices for data quality, security, governance, and responsible AI use within the team
    • Implement and maintain rigorous testing procedures to validate the accuracy and reliability of data, ML, and AI models

Requirements

    • Ph.D. in Economics, Machine Learning, Applied Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other quantitative discipline with 5+ years of relevant industry experience, or equivalent M.S. with 8+ years of relevant demonstrable research experience
    • Experience with the Life Sciences industry and applying analytics and AI/ML to related data sets
    • Hands-on experience building or deploying LLM-based systems (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine-tuning). Advanced, in-depth specialization in data science and AI techniques including classification, pattern recognition, clustering, feature analysis, NLP, fuzzy matching, sentiment analysis, A/B testing, active/adaptive learning
    • Proven leadership of teams of 10+ people
    • Intellectual curiosity, along with excellent problem-solving and quantitative skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions, even in situations with non-standard problems
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to effectively explain complex technical and AI-driven solutions to other team members and clients
    • Must be comfortable with changing requirements and priorities
    • Must be results-oriented and able to move forward without complete information and with minimal supervision

Nice to Have

    • Advanced experience with AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks
    • Data pipeline building skills
    • Product development experience
    • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) or vector databases
    • Experience designing AI-native products or workflows, not just adding AI to existing systems

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program
    • Unrivaled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
    • Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $250,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

raw.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
raw.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Lab Automation and Orchestration.
Lab automation is where science meets engineering. Robotics, liquid handlers, instruments, and scheduling software are moving labs from manual work toward automated, data driven, and eventually autonomous operation. While we are supporting fully automated labs, most labs still run as islands. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI.

We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.

This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. You’ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on autonomous labs and AI. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in lab automation. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.

How you’ll spend your time

  • Customer engagements: meeting automation leaders, scientists, and engineers, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business
  • Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors and automation vendors, and spotting trends early
  • Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win
  • Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the lab automation audience
  • Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on self driving labs and the future of the automated lab
  • Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get labs running on Luma and putting AI to work on automated workflows and data
  • Partner and ecosystem engagement: working with instrument makers, robotics providers, and integrators so our joint story is clear to customers
  • Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the lab automation market

The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to lab automation buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.

What you’ll do

  • Own the market strategy for Luma in lab automation, including workflow orchestration, scheduling, instrument integration, data capture, and autonomous lab concepts
  • Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Lab Automation, Automation Engineers, Discovery Technologies, Research IT, Core Facilities, and Operations leaders
  • Build positioning and messaging that speaks to automation engineers, scientists, IT leaders, and executives
  • Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it
  • Define and prove AI use cases for lab automation, including closed loop experimentation, smarter scheduling, and data prepared for tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo
  • Translate automation pain points into clear value, including less integration work, faster workflow changes, better use of instruments, trusted data, and a clear path from automation islands to connected labs
  • Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the lab automation market
  • Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story
  • Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, scheduling and orchestration tools, automation vendors, and in house builds
  • Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales
  • Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points
  • Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations
  • Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what automation teams tell us
  • Connect lab automation to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Biologics, and Tech Transfer
  • Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners
  • Track market trends, including autonomous labs, AI driven discovery, robotics, and data standards, and turn them into action

We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, lab automation, or scientific technology, with hands on experience in a pharma, biotech, CDMO, research institute, or automation vendor setting. You will bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case excellent writing and presentation skills. Ideally holding a degree in life sciences, engineering, robotics, or a related field, with a Masters or PhD a plus

The key skills

  • Deep understanding of how automated labs work day to day, including liquid handling, robotics, instrument integration, workflow scheduling, and the data that flows from them
  • Knowledge of how automation leaders make decisions, balance speed, cost, and flexibility, and work with scientists, IT, and engineering teams
  • Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, automation, informatics, or life sciences solutions company
  • Familiarity with scheduling and orchestration software, LIMS, ELN, or lab data platforms
  • A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt
  • Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging
  • Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers
  • Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organisation and build trust with teams in different regions and business units
  • Right to work in the UK

Nice to have

  • Experience running or supporting a lab automation team or an automated lab build
  • Knowledge of industrial automation concepts and how they apply to the lab
  • Familiarity with lab data standards and open interfaces
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting
  • Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, automation vendors, or research institutes
  • Experience working across the UK and European life sciences community

What success looks like

  • A clear lab automation market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing
  • Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use
  • One consistent story for lab automation across Dotmatics, DISW, and DI Automation
  • Growing software adoption and a library of proven AI use cases in lab automation
  • Industry voices who help tell our story
  • Growing pipeline and wins tied to lab automation
  • Automation leaders who can say, in their own words, why Luma helps them connect their labs and move toward autonomous operation

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12

Part time

$37.66 - $81.11

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

This is a remote position.

We are looking for COPAINALA ZOQUE<> English court interpreters for in-person, virtual, or hybrid services.
The Court Interpreter provides essential interpretation services to non-English speaking or hearing-impaired individuals in judicial settings. They play a pivotal role in ensuring that these individuals fully understand their rights, the court proceedings, and any communications from court officials.
Court Interpreter Job Description
Position Title: Court Interpreter
Department: Judicial Services
Reports To: Court Administrator or Designated Supervisor
Position Summary:
The Court Interpreter provides essential interpretation services to non-English speaking or hearing-impaired individuals in judicial settings. They play a pivotal role in ensuring that these individuals fully understand their rights, the court proceedings, and any communications from court officials.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Interpretation Services
Accurately interpret oral statements from one language into another in real-time during court proceedings.
Render a complete and accurate interpretation or translation without omitting, adding to, or altering the intended meaning.
Interpret for witnesses, defendants, plaintiffs, attorneys, judges, and other court personnel.
Document Translation
Translate written legal documents, including court notices, legal forms, and evidence.
Ensure the translated documents retain the original meaning and adhere to the court's requirements.
Maintain Confidentiality
Adhere to a strict code of ethics and maintain the confidentiality of all court-related information.
Avoid conflicts of interest and disclose any potential conflicts.
Continuous Learning
Stay updated on legal terminologies, court procedures, and the ethical guidelines of the profession.
Attend periodic trainings and workshops to enhance interpretation skills.
Cultural Sensitivity
Display awareness of cultural differences and nuances to ensure unbiased and respectful communication.
Provide insight into cultural backgrounds when necessary to aid in court proceedings.
Administrative Tasks
Coordinate and schedule interpretation sessions.
Maintain accurate records of interpretation services provided.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in languages, interpretation, or a related field.
  • Certification: Professional certification in court interpretation is preferred (e.g., from the National Association of Judiciary Interpreters and Translators or similar body).
  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional interpretation experience, preferably within a legal or court setting.
  • Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in English and at least one other language.
Skills:
  • Strong listening and speaking skills.
  • Thorough knowledge of legal terminology.
  • Ability to handle stress and emotionally charged situations.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong ethical judgment and professionalism.

Benefits

  • This is a 1099 Contract Position.
  • We pay twice per month on the 1st and 15th of each month.

1. Written and verbal bilingual, professional fluency in Spanish and English (interpreters and translators).

What we are seeking – Korean Linguists to support the federal and local law enforcement community by providing real time translation services in a fast-paced environment.
Job Summary:
Linguist is responsible for performing real-time translations or sensitive material from a foreign language into English; collecting, analyzing, identifying, and decoding of colloquialisms and slang terms; Extracting pertinent information and communicating that information to law enforcement agent(s). Linguist is responsible for transcribing and translating source documents and recordings from storage media, including but not limited to audio files, video files or digital media.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES​
  • Listens to oral intercepts in English or Foreign language and provides verbal and written synopsis. Linguist is responsible for relating all pertinent information to the Client.
  • Contribute to the master list of slang words and codes (used by that group/organization) for the duration of the project/case.
  • Maintains a voice library for the duration of the project.
  • During inactive or low periods of activity, transcribes and translates pertinent calls, other audio files and electronic messages assigned by their supervisor.
  • Produce court ready transcriptions and translations of pertinent calls following the required format.
  • Responsible for using the various reference tools created during the project
  • Ability to transcribe and translate a minimum of 18 - 22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8-hour day.
  • Operates specialized translation equipment provided by the government to include JSI voice box, Pen-link, Comverse, and other communication collection equipment used at their assigned site.
  • Maintain a daily log of productivity.
  • Duties are performed via a government approved computer system. Employees are required to possess strong computer skills in MS Word and Excel.
  • Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree AND three (3) years’ experience in a professional setting OR Associate degree AND five (5) years’ experience in a professional setting OR a High School Diploma AND seven (7) years of experience.
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Must have knowledge of source language colloquial terms and expressions.
  • Knowledgeable is SMS language, social media and Webchat.
  • Must be able to obtain a law enforcement sensitive clearance
  • Demonstrates excellent verbal and written skills in both the source and target language, including correct and accurate grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
  • Must be able to obtain an ALTA Language certificate in Foreign Language and English
  • Must possess strong computer skills in MS Office, including Microsoft Word and Excel; PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Requires strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with different departments within the company, employees and with clients.
  • Ability to take technical direction and feedback from various sources.
  • Must be able to identify and escalate non-technical issues to Operations Supervisor, Field and Site Supervisors and Team Leads in a timely and effective manner
  • Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representing TE in a Professional manner.
  • Requires the ability to prioritize work, meet stringent deadlines, balance multiple tasks and work in a team environment.
  • Must be able to testify based on completed work product
  • Ability to translate/transcribe 18-22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8/hour day when performing Linguist duties.
  • Ability to type 45 WPM
  • Available to work a minimum of 32 hours per week.
  • Must be available to work a flexible schedule, to include nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 32 consecutive labor hours per week, 8 hours per shift, when assigned to local projects
CLEARANCE:
Applicants selected may be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment.
SECURITY REQUIREMENTS:
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a Security Clearance
  • Favorable credit check for all cleared positions
  • Successfully pass a background investigation, medical and drug screen.
  • Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  • Must be a U.S Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Residency requirement -3 consecutive years in the last 5 years.
Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:
Standing/Walking/Mobility: Must have mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees.
Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time.
Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time.
Fingering/Grasping/Feeling: Must be able to write, type and use a telephone system 100% of the time.
Sitting: 90% to 95% of the time.

raw.description:
Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Liderar la estrategia global de marketing, comunicación y marca de Marketing Collection, consolidando su posicionamiento como empresa referente en la representación de marcas de turismo de lujo en LATAM. Será responsable de construir una marca sólida, generar visibilidad, engagement y oportunidades de negocio tanto con agencias como con marcas. Este rol combina visión estratégica, sensibilidad estética, liderazgo de equipo y orientación a resultados.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

1. Estrategia global de marketing

  • Diseñar e implementar el plan estratégico de marketing alineado con los objetivos de la empresa y el roadmap comercial.
  • Supervisar su ejecución en los diferentes países y canales, asegurando coherencia y rendimiento.

2. Gestión de marca (Brand Strategy)

  • Definir y custodiar la identidad de marca de Marketing Collection: visión, misión, valores y narrativa visual.
  • Supervisar la aplicación de la marca en todos los puntos de contacto: redes, web, presentaciones, eventos, brochures, emailings, etc.
  • Inspirar una experiencia de marca coherente, atractiva y emocionalmente conectada con agencias y marcas.

3. Posicionamiento y comunicación externa

  • Elevar el posicionamiento de MC como socio estratégico de confianza para marcas de turismo de lujo.

• Aumentar la presencia redes sociales

  • Dirigir campañas institucionales y tácticas (búsqueda de marcas, fidelización de agencias, awareness general).

4. Campañas y generación de leads

  • Diseñar e implementar campañas digitales para generación de leads B2B (marcas y agencias).
  • Liderar estrategias de inbound marketing, email marketing, paid media y alianzas.
  • Analizar resultados y optimizar las campañas en función del rendimiento.

5. Investigación de mercado y competencia

  • Investigar tendencias del sector, oportunidades de diferenciación y percepciones del mercado.
  • Detectar insights para la mejora del storytelling y la propuesta de valor de MC.

6. Liderazgo de equipo y cultura

  • Coordinar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de marketing.
  • Fomentar una cultura de iniciativa, responsabilidad y trabajo en equipo.
  • Delegar con claridad, empoderar y dar seguimiento a cada miembro del equipo.

7. Eventos y ecosistema

  • Participar en la planificación estratégica y comunicación de los eventos propios.
  • Diseñar materiales, storytelling, notas de prensa y cobertura digital de eventos.

8. Medición y reporting

  • Establecer KPIs claros de rendimiento de marketing.
  • Reportar avances y resultados al comité ejecutivo.

EXPERIENCIA Y COMPETENCIAS REQUERIDAS

Experiencia:

  • +5 años en roles de liderazgo en marketing estratégico y marca.
  • Experiencia en sectores relacionados: turismo, lujo, lifestyle, servicios premium o comunicación B2B.
  • Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinares.

Habilidades:

  • Visión estratégica y pensamiento sistémico
  • Sensibilidad estética y cuidado del detalle

raw.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED AND/OR PREFERRED:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline, preferably in regulatory, engineering, or biological science plus 3 or more years of relevant experience; in lieu of degree, 5 or more years of relevant experience may suffice.
  • RAC certification(s) a plus

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Technical Competencies

  • Computer Skills - Skilled with computers, takes advantage of new technology, learns new tools quickly, uses technology to enhance job performance
  • Budget - Uses resources efficiently, strives to reduce cost
  • Innovation - Creative, offers new ideas, amenable to change, risk taker
  • Job Knowledge - Understands facets of job, aware of duties and responsibilities, keeps job knowledge current. Strong understanding of other functional items including product development, design controls and risk management. Strong understanding of medical terminology, regulations, and guidelines related to medical devices and quality systems including FDA’s Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), MDD 93/42/EEC, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 13485.
  • Organization Skills - Information organized and accessible, maintains efficient workspace, manages time well
  • Product Expertise - Knows product features, understands marketplace, shares expertise with others
  • Professional Development - Seeks to identify one’s self-improvement opportunities at work and takes appropriate action to address
  • Project Management - Monitors status of projects, thoroughly deals with project details, holds project owners accountable, delivers clear, accurate depiction of status
  • Quality - Strives to eliminate errors, accurate work is a priority, seeks opportunities to improve product/services
  • Technical Skills - Maintains understanding of technical processes/equipment, uses technology to increase performance/productivity

Behavioral & Basic Skill Competencies

  • Adaptability - Adapts to change, open to new ideas and responsibilities
  • Communication – Communicates proficiently (written and verbal), delivers presentations, has good listening skills
  • Conflict Management - Good listener, committed to finding solution to problems, works well with difficult people
  • Customer Focus - Working cooperatively with internal and external customers in a manner that demonstrates a clear commitment to their needs and success
  • Decision Making - Able to reach decisions, takes thoughtful approach when considering options, seeks input from others, makes difficult decisions
  • Dependability - Meets deadlines, works independently, accountable, maintains focus, punctual, good attendance record
  • Details – High attention to detail
  • Ethics - Honest, accountable, maintains confidentiality
  • Initiative - Takes action, seeks new opportunities, strives to see projects to completion
  • Interpersonal Skills - Builds strong relationships, is flexible/adaptable, works well with others, solicits feedback
  • Problem Solving/Critical Thinking - Strives to understands contributing factors, works to resolve complex situations
  • Productivity - Manages workload, works efficiently, meets goals and objectives
  • Results Driven - Defines appropriate goals, works toward achieving goals, articulates vision and steps for achievement.
  • Results/Productivity - Working in a productive, dependable, and efficient manner to produce high quality results in accordance with deadlines and other expectations.
  • Self-Development - Looks for opportunities to increase knowledge, works to increase responsibility, strives to achieve personal goals
  • Sense of Urgency - Meets deadlines, establishes appropriate priority, gets the job done in a timely manner, able to work under pressure
  • Strategic Thought - Works to establish and articulate visions, shows creativity when defining solutions
  • Teamwork - Demonstrating high levels of teamwork and ability to work cross-functionally

This position requires the use of personal protective equipment during various tasks/activities including but not limited to scrubs, gloves, masks, safety glasses, and safety shoes.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Fanfix is a fast-growing, creator-focused startup aimed at empowering content creators to monetize their work through an exclusive content and subscription platform.
We are seeking a dynamic, scrappy, and experienced Chief Marketing Officer with a proven track record in performance and brand marketing with a history of achieving high Return on Advertising Spend (ROAS). If you thrive in a fast-paced startup environment and have a comprehensive understanding of consumer or creator-focused marketing, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

1.Develop, implement, and monitor a comprehensive marketing strategy that enhances brand awareness, drives customer growth, and aligns with our company's strategic goals.

2.Specialize in performance marketing, with a focus on maximizing ROAS across a diverse range of channels.

3.Manage brand activations to build a unique brand identity and oversee all promotional and marketing campaigns.

4.Design and oversee effective paid advertising campaigns, with a focus on high ROAS channels like Facebook, Instagram, SEO, podcast, and influencer marketing.

5.Lead, mentor, and inspire a dedicated marketing team, including a social media manager.

6.Establish, nurture, and manage relationships with external marketing and advertising agencies.

7.Track, analyze, and report marketing metrics to gauge success, guide future strategies, and optimize ROAS.

8.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure marketing strategies meet their needs.

9.Stay current on the latest trends in the creator economy and digital marketing landscape.

​

Qualifications:

1.Proven experience as a CMO or similar leadership role in a consumer, start-up, or creator-focused company, with a strong emphasis on performance marketing.

2.Exceptional knowledge and experience in maximizing ROAS across a variety of marketing and advertising channels.

3.Comprehensive understanding of various marketing and sales touchpoints.

4.Hands-on experience with digital marketing tools and techniques, including SEO, PPC, social media platforms, and more.

5.Strong knowledge of web analytics, with the ability to derive meaningful insights for business improvement.

6.Exceptional team management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

7.Excellent communication and presentation skills.

8.A visionary leader with a creative mind and data-driven approach.

At Fanfix, we believe in innovation, inclusivity, and the power of creativity. We are an equal-opportunity employer who is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are passionate about the future of the creator economy and can drive strong ROAS, we'd love to hear from you.
Location:
US Remote - Home Office (NYC, NY or Los Angeles, CA)

Benefits

  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Employee discounts on product
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

The pay range for this role is between $200,000 - $250,000. Actual pay within the range is dependent on multiple factors, including your residence location and prior work experience. Equity, benefits, and a discretionary bonus may be additional forms of compensation for this role and are not included in the provided pay range.
